machineTranscript.method: OpenAI Whisper small, language=en, CPU, fp16=false
machineTranscript.role: Used only to confirm that English dialogue spans the full video and to compare broad speaker/caption timing; not used as verbatim ground truth where it conflicts with visually checked burned captions.
limitations: The model misrecognized Yakuza, stocks, houseplants, Ontario and other words.
Machine speech recognition cannot establish who authored or voiced the dialogue.
It cannot by itself determine whether lip motion was automatically driven, manually animated or edited.

nonSpeechAudioDecision.finding: A decodable audio stream and continuous English dialogue are established. The type, provenance and narrative role of any music, ambience or sound effects cannot be reliably identified with the available evidence and remain unknown.
